pieces.Text: You can choke foes with a lasso.

When you successfully entangle a creature with a lasso (Advanced Player's Guide 178) and beat the target's CMD by 5 or more, the target cannot speak above a whisper and must succeed at a concentration check (DC = 20 +your CMB +the spell level) to cast a spell with a verbal component, use a command word item, or use any magic requiring speech. Additionally, the DC of an Escape Artist check to slip free of a lasso you are using equals 15 or your CMD, whichever is higher.
